name: se7enxweb/cjw-config-processor
description: se7enxweb fork of cjw-network/cjw-config-processor 2.x for Exponential Platform Nexus, PHP 7.1 to 8.5. Inspired by the INI viewer of the legacy kernel: parses the configuration of your Symfony server / eZ - / Ibexa platform and allows visual access to the configuration in a human readable way for a better development experience.
